text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Super Creek receives a letter from a<n>young fan.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It says, "When I grow up, I want to be<n>an
Umamusume just like you."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You can see so many eraser<n>smudges on the
paper.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I bet she poured her heart and soul<n>into writing this
for me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, how adorable. I wonder what I<n>should write
back in my thank you<n>letter.
choice_data_list:
Maybe something like, "Let's run together one
day"?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, what a lovely dream she has.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: There isn't much I can give to this<n>child right now...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
But I need to train my heart out so<n>that we do end
up running together<n>one day! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
That day, Super Creek takes on her<n>training
session with a smile on her<n>face and a spring in her
step.
